Lena (AE): Quick sync - prospect in EU banking wants a 2-week POC. Must be EU-data-only, BYOK for at-rest, and wants list of any subprocessors processing telemetry. Can we do that without full Private deployment?
Marco (Solutions Eng): Short: hosted-prod doesn't meet strict BYOK. We have two options: Dedicated tenant pinned to EU cloud region (supports customer KMS for Dedicated via restricted key-wrapping) or Private VPC/on-prem for full BYOK. Dedicated can be faster.
Nora (Legal Ops): Need to see exact wording on 'EU-data-only' and BYOK requirement. Also: do they require subprocessor contractual flow-down? If so, we'll need to produce the EU subproc attestation and possibly an addendum.
Lena (AE): They said: "no third-party export of data outside EU; BYOK required for all production keys; list of subprocessors that may access metadata; incident notif within 24h."
Tariq (Infra Eng): Technical constraints: we can pin inference nodes to eu-west-1 / westeurope. For Dedicated we can set routing-policy to prefer EU egress and disable failover to other regions. However some infra services (monitoring/observability) currently route logs to partner endpoints that have EU-only processing flags — need attestation.
Marco (Solutions Eng): I'll paste a sample routing policy snippet they can review:
```
tenant_routing:
  primary_region: eu-west-1
  allow_cross_region_failover: false
  kms_integration: dedicated_byok
  telemetry_retention: eu-only
```
Lena (AE): Nice. Pricing question: they want short 2-week POC cost; prefer not to commit to a month. Can we give a short-term Dedicated eval rate?
Marco (Solutions Eng): We can offer a time-boxed Dedicated eval: flat fee covering reserved capacity + support. Ballpark: €9k/week for a small DN (includes support & minimal tokens). Private on-prem one-off infra setup is ~€70k + ops. I'll confirm EUR prices with finance.
Nora (Legal Ops): On subprocessors: we can give them the public subproc list (GCP eu-west, AWS eu-west-1, Azure westeurope) + monitoring vendor (EU processing), CDN (EU POPs). But clarify: "may access metadata" — metadata access is limited to ops and oncall; we need to map who has access and under what controls. I need Marco/Tariq to supply the attestation PDF and an access-control summary.
Tariq (Infra Eng): Will do. Note: for Dedicated we can centralize logs to customer S3/GCS in EU. For Private, KMS calls occur in-customer-network. For Hosted we cannot meet BYOK.
Lena (AE): Timeline: customer wants POC start in 10 business days. Is Dedicated realistic?
Tariq (Infra Eng): If capacity available, we can provision a Dedicated eval tenant in ~7-10 days with infra onboarding + test keys. If we need new capacity allocation in region, add 2 weeks.
Marco (Solutions Eng): Next steps for us: 1) provide EU subproc PDF + attestation, 2) provide routing-policy snippet and SOW sample language for BYOK/KMS, 3) provide Dedicated eval pricing quote.
Nora (Legal Ops): I'll queue the checklist review. If they insist on "no subprocessors outside EU", we must flag that some corporate vendor admin metadata (HR/ops) may be outside EU and we'll need an exception or contract carveout. Ask them to highlight exact clause text.
Lena (AE): I'll get back with the customer's exact clause and confirm whether they accept "EU-only processing for customer data and EU-residency for telemetry where possible" language.
deploy-bot: created-routing-template v2 (id: rtpl-eu-2026) :white_check_mark:
Marco (Solutions Eng): Attestation doc uploaded to /internal/attestations/eu-subprocs.pdf. I'll DM Nora the access. Also attaching a short KMS onboarding checklist in the thread.
Tariq (Infra Eng): KMS checklist highlights: customer IAM role, trust policy, certificate exchange, key-usage policy, rotation window. Add these to SOW.
Nora (Legal Ops): Once I review attestation and the checklist, I'll draft the DPA addendum and indicate any exceptions. If they require SOC2 report for specific subprocessors, note that some partners provide EU SOC2-equivalent docs, others supply ISO/IEC certs.
Lena (AE): Great. I'll draft the customer-facing POC proposal with the Dedicated eval rate and timeline and post here before sending. Thanks all.
